scope: Fictional homepage and robots.txt. Demonstration data only; no website was scanned.

findings.title: A title that identifies the business
findings.evidence: Illustrative HTML: <title>Harbor Studio | Website design for local businesses</title>.
findings.meaning: The example title names the business and its service. This does not establish a ranking or an AI recommendation.
findings.action: Keep titles accurate and specific to each page. Confirm the service description with the business.

findings.title: Search crawler policy needs review
findings.evidence: Illustrative robots.txt: User-agent: OAI-SearchBot followed by Disallow: /.
findings.meaning: This example asks OpenAI's search crawler not to crawl the site. A robots policy is not a live test of crawler access or proof of zero visibility.
findings.action: Ask the site owner whether this restriction is intentional. Review search access separately from model-training preferences before changing it.

findings.title: The service description needs a clearer answer
findings.evidence: Illustrative opening copy: We deliver innovative digital solutions. It does not identify the deliverable, intended customer, or next step.
findings.meaning: A reader has to infer what is being offered. This is a qualitative content observation, not a search-engine scoring rule.
findings.action: State the service, audience, and project process in visible text. Add supporting details the business can substantiate.

findings.title: No JSON-LD block in the example
findings.evidence: The fictional HTML contains no application/ld+json script block.
findings.meaning: JSON-LD is one way to describe entities. Its absence is not an automatic failure and does not establish whether other structured data is present.
findings.action: Consider supported structured data that matches the visible page. Do not add invented reviews, ratings, or unsupported claims.

training.note: Fictional training-policy example. Training permissions and search discovery are different decisions.

limitations: DEMONSTRATION DATA ONLY. Harbor Studio and sample.example are fictional examples, not clients or measured results.
The four findings explain the report format. They are not the complete automated checklist or an actual scan.
No ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, or Google AI answer was collected for this example.
No website changes were made. No before-and-after improvement is claimed.
